title: WatchView reads window.localStorage at module load outside any try/catch
test: tests/mediaDebug.test.js: 'WatchView reads storage at module scope only through the safe accessor'
proof: On the unchanged code the new source-level test failed (assert.doesNotMatch: WatchView must not touch window.localStorage directly; src/WatchView.jsx line 22 passed window.localStorage as an argument, so the property getter ran before isMediaDebugEnabled could guard it). WatchView cannot be imported under node:test (JSX), so the test reads the source, the same way tests/howToSecurityCopy.test.js does. After the fix WatchView line 22 is isMediaDebugEnabled(window.location, getLocalStorageSafely(window)), reusing the helper TASK-068 added; the existing test with a throwing localStorage getter already covers the helper returning null and the flag resolving to false. The Playwright check was not run in this item.
